widgets_values: Extract the surface pattern of the picture product and render it as a complete, standalone vector graphic.  The final illustration must be visually balanced, with all fabric wrinkles, shadows, and textures removed.  Ensure precise 1:1 detail replication and clean, refined edges.

The "length" sets the amount of layers. I will add a node to make this more user friendly in the future. For now:
帧数 5  -> 1 层
帧数 9  -> 2 层
帧数 13 -> 3 层
帧数 17 -> 4 层
帧数 21 -> 5 层
